ribbon_font_size_title: Font size (\large) for what is chosen beside it. Shows the size at the cursor. The points refer to the document's base font size.
ribbon_size_scope_title: What the font size applies to: the word at the cursor (with a selection, the selected text), the paragraph at the cursor (with a selection, every selected paragraph), the section at the cursor, or the whole document.
ribbon_align_left_title: Align left (ragged right). Applies to what is chosen beside it. If it is left-aligned already, it goes back to justified text.
ribbon_align_center_title: Center. Applies to what is chosen beside it. If it is centered already, it goes back to justified text.
ribbon_align_right_title: Align right. Applies to what is chosen beside it. If it is right-aligned already, it goes back to justified text.
ribbon_align_justify_title: Justified text, LaTeX's default. Applies to what is chosen beside it; undoes any other alignment there.
ribbon_bullets_title: Insert a bulleted list (itemize) at the cursor; selected paragraphs become its items. In a numbered list: turn it into bullets.
ribbon_numbering_title: Insert a numbered list (enumerate) at the cursor; selected paragraphs become its items. In a bulleted list: number it.
ribbon_multilevel_title: Insert a numbered list with a second level (1., a., …) at the cursor. In a list: add a level below.
ribbon_spacing_title: Choose the line spacing for what is chosen beside it (setspace package; a multiple of LaTeX's normal line spacing), and the space between the paragraphs of the whole document.
ribbon_spacing_scope_title: What the line spacing applies to: the paragraph at the cursor (with a selection, every selected paragraph), the section at the cursor, or the whole document.
bullets_selection: The selection contains headings, environments or list items and cannot be turned into a list.
bullets_no_file: Open a .tex file and set a main file to insert a list.
ribbon_page_break_title: Start a new page at the cursor (\clearpage); figures and tables before it still go on the pages before.
page_break_no_file: Open a .tex file and set a main file to insert a page break.
style_normal_title: Set the paragraph at the cursor as normal text
style_heading_title: Make the paragraph at the cursor a heading ({command})
style_numbered_title: Pressed when the heading at the cursor gets a number in the document. A click sets it without a number (\section*) or numbers it; where the document does not number its level yet, it then numbers all headings of that level (secnumdepth).
numbering_menu_title: Down to which heading level the whole document numbers headings (secnumdepth) and lists them in the table of contents (tocdepth)
ribbon_footnote_title: Insert a footnote at the cursor (\footnote)
ribbon_sources_title: Cite sources and add new ones to the bibliography by DOI, ISBN or a form
cite_no_document: Open a .tex file and a main file to cite.
cite_invalid_entry: The source is not a valid BibTeX entry.
cite_lookup_invalid: That is neither a DOI nor an ISBN.
cite_lookup_not_found: No source was found for this identifier.
cite_lookup_failed: The source could not be fetched: {error}
cite_filter: Search by author, title, year or key …
cite_no_sources: The project has no sources yet.
cite_no_bibliography: The document has no bibliography yet.
cite_lookup_hint: Fetches the details from doi.org or Open Library. Or fill in the fields below yourself.
page_numbers_regions_hint: The numbering can change or start over from any row. A change starts on a new page.
page_numbers_no_pdf: PDF pages and first numbers appear after the first build.
page_numbers_changed: The document changed while the dialog was open. Please open it again.
ribbon_header_footer_title: Choose what stands at the top and bottom of each page: page number, chapter, title or your own text
ribbon_title_title: Set the document's title, authors and date
ribbon_note_title: Insert notes for revising, go through them, or hide them for handing in
header_footer_number_loading: Reading the parts of the document …
header_footer_hint: Pages where a chapter starts show only the page number.
title_make: Set the title at the start of the document (\maketitle)
title_own_page: On a title page of its own
title_hint: The fields may contain LaTeX, such as \\ for a line break.
ribbon_columns_title: Set text in columns: the whole document or the selected part
ribbon_symbols_title: Insert characters the keyboard lacks: €, ©, §, dashes, quotation marks, a non-breaking space …
symbols_fallback_font: From the fallback font FreeSerif, which the document gets in its preamble for it; the document's font lacks the character.
symbols_cyrillic_text: For Cyrillic text: the document loads the T2A encoding.
symbols_math_only: A math symbol: in running text it comes in $…$.
ribbon_search_title: Find and replace in the open file (Ctrl+F)
search_replaced: Replaced: {count}. Ctrl+Z undoes it file by file.
problem_undefined_command: LaTeX does not know the command {command}: a typo, or a package that is missing.
problem_undefined_command_package: The command {command} comes from the package {package}, which the document does not load.
problem_undefined_environment: The environment {environment} is unknown: a typo, or a package that is missing.
problem_undefined_environment_package: The environment {environment} comes from the package {package}, which the document does not load.
problem_missing_dollar: A formula character (_ or ^, \alpha …) stands in ordinary text. Put the formula in $…$, or write the character as \_.
problem_alignment_tab: The character & (or #) has a job in LaTeX, such as separating table columns. As a character in the text it is written \& (or \#).
problem_braces: A curly brace is missing or one too many. Check that every opening brace has a closing one.
problem_extra_alignment: A table row has more cells (&) than the table defines columns.
problem_no_line: \\ (line break) stands where no line ends, for instance after a blank line. Remove it, or use a blank line for a new paragraph.
problem_lonely_item: \item stands outside a list. It belongs in itemize, enumerate or description.
problem_file_not_found: The file {file} was not found. Check its path and spelling, including upper and lower case.
problem_citation_undefined: The source {key} is in none of the project's .bib files. Check the key, or add the source.
problem_empty_bibliography: The bibliography is empty: nothing has been cited yet, or the sources are missing.
problem_reference_undefined: The cross-reference to {key} has no matching \label. After the first build that is normal; if the message stays, the label is missing.
problem_rerun: Page numbers or references have changed. Compile once more and they will be right.
problem_unicode: pdfLaTeX cannot set the character {character}. LuaLaTeX can, with the system's fonts.
problem_overfull: A line sticks {width} pt into the margin, mostly a long word or an address LaTeX cannot break. Mark a break point with \- or rephrase.
problem_underfull: A line or page is set very loosely. Mostly harmless, often caused by \\ or blank lines in an awkward place.
problem_float_too_large: A figure or table is larger than the page. Make it smaller, e.g. width=\linewidth.
problem_option_clash: The package {package} is loaded twice with different options. Merge the options into one \usepackage line.
problem_notes_margin: The margin column is too narrow for margin notes; they are then broken into very short lines.
problem_missing_number: Where a number or length is expected, something else stands, for instance a missing unit (2cm instead of 2).
problem_missing_begin_document: Text stands before the document part ( egin document). The preamble holds only settings; the text comes after it.
problem_environment_mismatch: The environment {begin} is closed by the end of {end}. Its own \end is missing or in the wrong place.
problem_emergency_stop: LaTeX stopped. The cause is the first error further up.
problem_bib_file_missing: The bibliography file {file} is missing. Check the name in \addbibresource, or create the file.
ribbon_align_scope_title: What the alignment buttons apply to: the paragraph at the cursor (with a selection, every selected paragraph), the section at the cursor, or the whole document.
scope_fallback: Goes back to the default “{scope}” when you leave the tab.
ribbon_bold_title: Bold (\textbf) for what is chosen beside it; with no word at the cursor, for what is typed next. Click again to undo it.
ribbon_italic_title: Italic (\textit) for what is chosen beside it; with no word at the cursor, for what is typed next. Click again to undo it.
ribbon_underline_title: Underline (\underline; across lines \uline) for what is chosen beside it; with no word at the cursor, for what is typed next. Click again to undo it.
ribbon_strikethrough_title: Strike out (\sout, ulem package) what is chosen beside it; with no word at the cursor, what is typed next. Click again to undo it.
ribbon_text_color_title: Colors what is chosen beside it (\textcolor, xcolor package); with no word at the cursor, what is typed next. The arrow shows the colors.
ribbon_highlight_title: Highlights what is chosen beside it as with a marker (\hlc, with lua-ul under LuaLaTeX, otherwise with soul); with no word at the cursor, what is typed next. The arrow shows the colors.
ribbon_emphasis_scope_title: What bold, italic, underline, strikethrough, font color and highlight color apply to: the word at the cursor (with a selection, the selected text), the paragraph at the cursor (with a selection, every selected paragraph), the section at the cursor, or the whole document (bold, italic and font color only).
ribbon_font_family_title: Font for what is chosen beside it (with a selection, the selected text). LaTeX fonts work with every engine, system fonts only with LuaLaTeX and XeLaTeX. Shows the font at the cursor.
ribbon_font_scope_title: What the font applies to: the word at the cursor (with a selection, the selected text), the paragraph at the cursor (with a selection, every selected paragraph), the section at the cursor, or the whole document.
fonts_error: The font catalog is not available: {error}
fonts_needs_unicode: Not usable with pdfLaTeX. Switch the project to XeLaTeX or LuaLaTeX to use this font.
fonts_consent_text: To preview fonts that are not installed, Gilgamesh downloads their packages from the TeX Live server {server}. This sends your IP address to that server. Installed fonts always show without downloading anything.
fonts_downloads_title: Downloads previews of fonts not installed from {server}, which sends your IP address. Off: only installed fonts and those you click on.
fonts_choose: Choose a font to learn more about it and use it.
format_no_document: The main file has no document body (\begin document) to set the formatting in.
format_no_paragraph: There is no paragraph of text at the cursor to format.
format_no_section: There is no heading before the cursor whose section could be formatted.
engine_switch_to_unicode: Switching to LuaLaTeX or XeLaTeX, Gilgamesh sets the document's fonts with fontspec (\setmainfont). Packages and settings meant for pdfLaTeX may behave differently or stop working; line and page breaks may change.
engine_switch_to_pdflatex: Switching to pdfLaTeX, Gilgamesh sets the document's fonts with LaTeX fonts. pdfLaTeX can use neither system fonts nor fontspec; features that rely on them stop working, and line and page breaks may change.
engine_switch_lost: These system fonts are dropped; the default font takes their place: {fonts}
engine_switch_unsupported: These packages do not work with pdfLaTeX and have to be replaced by hand: {packages}
ribbon_link_title: Insert a link to a web page or e-mail address (\href); selected text becomes the link text. Loads hyperref where it is missing.
ribbon_reference_title: Refer to a heading, figure, table or equation (\autoref, \ref, \pageref …); clickable in the PDF.
link_web_hint: https:// is added to an address without it, mailto: to an e-mail address. The text is clickable in the PDF.
link_none: The document has no headings or labels yet.
link_no_file: Open a .tex file for the link to go into.
link_heading_changed: The heading “{title}” is no longer where it was. The reference was inserted, the label is still missing.
ribbon_margins_title: Set the page margins of the whole document (geometry package)
ribbon_orientation_title: Portrait or landscape for the whole document (geometry package)
ribbon_paper_title: The paper size of the whole document (geometry package)
page_setup_no_document: Open a project with a main file to set up the page; beamer presentations do not support it.
margins_two_sided: The document is two-sided: the inside margin is the one at the binding.
margins_class_default: So far the document class sets the margins. These values replace them.
margins_too_large: These margins leave no room for text on the page.
margins_unsupported: Margins can't be set for this document: presentations (beamer) have fixed margins, and the main file needs a \documentclass.
margins_no_document: Open a project with a main file to set its margins.
settings_units_text: The unit Gilgamesh shows lengths in, such as page margins, and writes them into the document with. Unless you choose one, it follows the measurement system of the Windows region settings.
file_new_text: Create a new project from a template.
file_open_text: Open a project folder or one of your recent projects.
print_pages_invalid: Invalid range. The document has {count} pages.
print_no_pdf: No PDF yet. Compile the project to print it.
print_partial: Only the current chapter is compiled. Turn off the current-chapter option for the whole document.
file_import_hint: Choose a ZIP file, e.g. an Overleaf download
pane_detach_title: Open in a window of its own (or drag the tab out of the window, or double-click it)
pane_dock_title: Bring back into the main window (or double-click the tab)
pane_none_docked: Editor and PDF preview are closed or in windows of their own. Bring them back under “Window”.
ribbon_pane_dock_title: Show the {pane} in the main window
ribbon_pane_detach_title: Open the {pane} in a window of its own, e.g. on a second screen
ribbon_pane_close_title: Close the {pane}; it comes back when you open a file
ribbon_pane_reset_title: Show editor and PDF preview side by side in the main window
pane_divider_title: Drag to resize, double-click to fit the whole PDF page
review_accept_all_title: Accept all of the AI's changes; they become the new version
review_reject_all_title: Discard all of the AI's changes; the previous text comes back
review_accept_title: Accept this change by the AI
review_reject_title: Discard this change by the AI
ribbon_history_title: Show and restore earlier versions of the open file
history_hint: A version is saved when a file is opened and then at most once every 5 minutes. Restoring can be undone with Ctrl+Z.
ribbon_auto_save_title: Save changes shortly after typing. When off, only Ctrl+S, switching files and closing save; compiling still uses the current text.
ribbon_auto_install_title: Install missing packages, fonts and language files without asking, then recompile
auto_install_offer:
Gilgamesh recommends installing missing LaTeX packages, fonts and language files automatically as soon as a document needs them.

These are external packages from TeX Live (CTAN), not part of Gilgamesh. They are downloaded from the internet.

You can change this at any time under “{tab}” with the “{checkbox}” checkbox.
packages_user_folder_title: Open the folder for custom .sty/.cls files
uninstall_confirm: The LaTeX distribution will be deleted. Custom packages in your user folder are kept.
settings_appearance_text: Color scheme of the interface. PDF pages stay white, as they are printed.
settings_about_notices_text: Gilgamesh includes software and data made by others. Their licenses, as shipped with the app:
settings_about_notices_missing: The license notices could not be loaded.
settings_about_license_text: Gilgamesh is free software: you can redistribute it and/or modify it under the terms of the GNU General Public License, version 3 or (at your option) any later version. Gilgamesh comes without any warranty, without even the implied warranty of merchantability or fitness for a particular purpose.
settings_about_license_names: The names “Gilgamesh” and “PigeonBits” and their logos are not covered by the GPL. A modified version must use a different name and logo.
settings_updates_text: New versions of Gilgamesh come from its releases on GitHub. Only versions signed by its developer are installed, and only when you choose to.
settings_updates_manual: This copy of Gilgamesh was not installed with an installer, so it cannot update itself. Download the new version and install it over this one.
settings_updates_lost_missing: Gilgamesh can no longer find its updates on GitHub. Download the new version from the website and install it over this one.
settings_updates_lost_untrusted: The new version is not signed with the key this version knows, so it was not installed. Download it from the website and install it over this one.
settings_updates_auto_text: A minute after the start and then once a day. Nothing is installed without asking you.
update_confirm: Install Gilgamesh {version}? Your files are saved first; Gilgamesh then closes and starts again with the new version.
update_closing: Your files are saved. Gilgamesh is installing the update and will start again.
update_release_missing: No release with updates was found on GitHub.
update_failed: The update could not be installed: {error}
update_none_found: No update was found to install. Check again.
update_cannot_install: This copy of Gilgamesh cannot update itself. Download the new version instead.
update_tex_busy: LaTeX packages are being installed or removed. Update once that is done.
update_save_failed: The update was stopped because a file could not be saved: {error}
update_save_timeout: The update was stopped because not every window saved its files in time.
ribbon_current_only_title: Compile only the open chapter (\includeonly) – faster for large documents. Only for files pulled in with \include.
project_settings_text: These settings apply to this project only and are stored in {file} in the project folder.
project_settings_pdf_standard_hint: Gilgamesh adds \DocumentMetadata only in the build, never to your file.
project_settings_spell_hint: Automatic uses the language from babel or polyglossia. The dictionary is downloaded on first use.
dictionary_text: Words spell checking should accept. They apply in every language and to all projects in this Gilgamesh installation, including foreign words in your text.
dictionary_empty: No words yet. Hover an underlined word in the editor and choose “Add to dictionary”.
bundle_standard_text: About 100 common packages, roughly 75 MB download. More packages can be installed at any time.
bundle_extended_text: Additional frequently requested packages, roughly 175 MB download.
setup_text: Gilgamesh manages its own LaTeX distribution (TinyTeX, based on TeX Live). It lives entirely in the app folder and does not modify your system.
catalog_more: … {count} more. Refine your search to see them.
remove_confirm: Remove package “{name}”? Documents that use it will no longer compile.
task_upgrade_release: New TeX Live release: reinstalling TinyTeX …
progress_restore: Reinstalling {count} packages of the previous installation …
error_catalog_offline: Online catalog unreachable, showing installed packages. ({error})
pdf_fit_page: Fit whole page (100 %, width matched to the page)
zoom_input_title: Zoom in percent ({min}–{max}) – type a value and press Enter; arrow keys change it in steps of 10
editor_line_to_pdf: Show this line in the PDF
pdf_sync_hint: Double-click to jump to the source
pdf_install_link: Install it now under Settings › Packages
settings_language_text: Language of the user interface. Changes apply immediately.
ribbon_problems_show_title: Show the problems panel below the editor; with errors or warnings it appears by itself
ribbon_problems_hide_title: Hide the problems panel; the status bar still counts errors and warnings
ribbon_problems_unignore_title: Show the warnings ignored in this project again ({count})
problems_not_found_title: No TeX Live package provides this file. Check its path and name in the project.
problems_follow_ups_show: {count} more messages – likely caused by the missing file, they go away after installing. Show
problems_install_all_title: Install missing packages one after another and recompile until none are missing
problems_copy_all_title: Copy all messages to the clipboard
problems_ignore_title: Stop showing this warning in this project
status_words_title: Text: {text} · Headings: {headers} · Captions etc.: {captions} — click for the words per chapter
project_dialog_new: Choose where to create the project
template_article_text: A simple article to get started.
template_thesis_text: Chapters as separate files, bibliography with biblatex, PDF/A-2b.
import_dialog: Choose a ZIP file with a LaTeX project
start_text: A project is a folder containing your .tex files. The project’s main file is what gets compiled, and changes are saved automatically.
sidebar_resize: Drag to change the width; double-click to reset
file_git_hint: Create a project as a Git repository or clone an existing one
git_init_text: Creates a new project from a template, sets it up as a Git repository and saves the first state as a commit. If you like, it is uploaded to your Git server right away.
git_clone_text: Downloads an existing repository over HTTPS or SSH and opens it as a project.
git_intro_folder: This project folder is not a Git repository yet. Set it up as a repository or clone an existing one as a new project.
git_init_folder_title: Set up this project folder as a Git repository. Its files then show up as changes you can commit.
git_connect_remote_title: Enter an empty repository on GitHub, GitLab or similar as remote to publish the branch there
git_remote_hint: An empty repository you created on GitHub, GitLab or similar. Leave empty to work locally only; you can publish later in the Git tab.
git_identity_text: Git records who made each commit. These details apply to all your repositories.
git_init_problem: The project was created and opened, but not everything worked. You can publish it later in the Git tab with “Publish branch”.
git_clone_title: Download a Git repository over HTTPS or SSH and open it as a project
git_url_invalid: This is not a Git link. Expected an HTTPS or SSH link, e.g. https://github.com/name/project.git or git@github.com:name/project.git.
git_not_found: Git is not installed on this system. Gilgamesh uses the Git on your computer: install it, then check again.
git_trust_title: Do you trust the authors of this repository?
git_trust_text: A repository can name programs in its .git folder that Git starts, for instance when it lists changes or commits. Trust it only if you created it yourself or trust where it came from. Without trust, Git stays off here; editing and compiling keep working.
git_untrusted: Git is off for this repository until you confirm that you trust its authors: its configuration could make Git start programs.
git_refresh: Refresh and fetch from the remote
git_sync_title: Pull {behind} commits from the remote and push {ahead}
git_no_changes: No changes since the last commit.
outline_empty: No headings found. The outline follows the main file and the files it \input-s or \include-s.
outline_move_shared: “{title}” cannot be moved: a moved section must stand alone in a .tex file of its own. {file} holds further sections or text before it. Move the section into a file of its own to use this function.
outline_move_line: {file} cannot be moved: the line that reads it in holds more code. \input or \include must stand alone on its line.
outline_move_twice: {file} is read in more than once, so it is not clear which place to move.
outline_move_nested: {file} is read in with \include and cannot go into a file that is itself read in with \include.
outline_move_position: The section cannot be moved to this place.
outline_move_changed: The files no longer match the outline. Please wait a moment and try again.
outline_move_review: Changes by the AI in {file} still await review. Accept or reject them first.
outline_extract_question: Move the section into a file of its own automatically and then move it?
outline_extract_failed: The section cannot be extracted automatically: its line in {file} holds more code before the heading.
outline_appendix_hint: Dropped above, a section goes to the end of the main part; below, into the appendix
sidebar_main_file: Main file – this is what gets compiled
sidebar_ai_created: Created by the AI – awaiting review
sidebar_ai_deleted: Deleted by the AI – awaiting review
editor_no_file: Select a file on the left or create a new one.
pdf_no_main: This project has no main file yet.
error_import_skipped: Not added: {names}. The project explorer only shows {extensions} files.
error_latex_missing: LaTeX is not installed. Install it under Settings › Packages.
error_log_missing: The log file is missing: the TeX engine did not start.
error_project_not_open: No access to {path}: this window did not open the project.
error_file_outside_projects: No access to {path}: the file is in none of this window's projects.
error_zip_too_many_entries: The ZIP file has more than {count} entries.
error_zip_too_large: The ZIP file unpacks to more than {size} GB.
error_config_damaged: {file} is damaged; Gilgamesh leaves it unchanged.
error_dictionary_download: The dictionary for {language} could not be downloaded: {error}
error_release_unavailable: The TinyTeX release could not be fetched: {error}
error_checksum: The checksum of {file} does not match: the download is not the published file.
error_archive_invalid: The archive contained no TinyTeX folder.
error_distribution_move: The TeX distribution could not be moved into place: {error}
error_package_index_loading: The package database is not loaded yet.
error_not_distribution_font: Not a font file of the TeX distribution: {file}
error_git_missing: Git was not found on this system.
error_git_detached: No branch is checked out (detached HEAD).
error_git_no_remote: The repository has no remote to sync with.
error_git_identity_incomplete: Name and email address are required.
log_new_release: New TeX Live release ({reason}): reinstalling TinyTeX …
log_packages_unavailable: No longer available or not installable: {packages}
build_engine_crashed: The TeX engine crashed; the log is incomplete.
build_image_converted: “{file}” is a {actual} image, not {expected}. Gilgamesh converts it when compiling; saved as a real {expected}, it also works in other LaTeX programs.
build_image_unconvertible: “{file}” is a {actual} image, not {expected}, and could not be converted ({error}). Save it as {expected}.
build_image_unreadable: “{file}” is a {actual} image. TeX only includes PDF, PNG and JPEG; save it as {expected}.
build_image_unknown: “{file}” is not an image TeX can read. TeX only includes PDF, PNG and JPEG; save it as {expected}.
assistant_text: Connect your Claude assistant to Gilgamesh.
assistant_desktop_missing: Claude Desktop is not installed on this computer.
assistant_confirm_install: Now confirm the installation in Claude Desktop. If needed, uninstall and install again.
assistant_restart_desktop: Done. Quit Claude Desktop completely (including its icon in the taskbar's notification area) and start it again.
assistant_code_done: Done. Gilgamesh is available in new Claude Code sessions.
assistant_not_running: The interface for assistants could not be started.
assistant_openai_text: Connect your OpenAI assistant to Gilgamesh.
assistant_codex_done: Done. Gilgamesh is available in new Codex sessions. Gilgamesh has to stay open while Codex works with it.
assistant_codex_missing: Codex is not installed on this computer.
shortcuts_text: Shortcuts under “Editor”, “PDF preview” and “Project explorer” work once you have clicked into that area.
shortcut_sync_from_pdf: Jump to the position in the source
ribbon_lists_title: Insert and edit lists: contents, figures, bibliography …
ribbon_image_title: Insert an image at the cursor, with caption and label
image_none: No images in the project yet
image_drop: Drag a picture here, or click to choose one from disk
image_drop_wrong: “{name}” is not a picture. Possible are {extensions}.
image_hint: Inserted at the cursor in {file}; graphicx is loaded in the main file if needed.
image_no_file: Open a .tex file in the editor to insert an image.
ribbon_table_title: Insert a table at the cursor, with caption and label
ribbon_formula_title: Insert a formula at the cursor, around the selected text
ribbon_structures_title: Insert a fraction, root, sum and more at the cursor; in running text inside $…$
formula_no_file: Open a .tex file and set a main file to insert a formula.
table_hint: Inserted at the cursor in {file}; missing packages are loaded in the main file.
table_no_file: Open a .tex file in the editor to insert a table.
lists_none: The document has no lists yet.
lists_hint: The file is included in the main file {main}; missing packages are added there.
lists_no_document: The main file has no document body (\begin document … \end document) to include the list in.
lists_exists: The main file already has a list of this kind; the new one is added as well.
lists_structure_hint: Drag or move with the arrow keys to choose the position
lists_toc: List in the table of contents
lists_bibtex_exists: The project uses BibTeX and the main file already has a bibliography (\bibliography); BibTeX allows only one.
lists_changed: The main file has changed meanwhile. Please choose the position again.
lists_heading_default: As the document class sets it
lists_edit_file: The list is in {file}, included in {main} at line {line}. Removing it moves the file to the recycle bin.
lists_edit_main: The list is in the main file {main} itself, line {line}.
